INPUTS = {'health/disk.tsv': 'mount\tused\tcapacity\tenabled\n/volume/00\t89\t100\tno\n/volume/01\t90\t100\tyes\n/volume/02\t91\t100\tyes\n/volume/03\t0\t100\tyes\n/volume/04\t100\t100\tyes\n/volume/05\t89\t100\tyes\n/volume/06\t90\t100\tyes\n/volume/07\t91\t100\tno\n/volume/08\t0\t100\tyes\n/volume/09\t100\t100\tyes\n/volume/10\t89\t100\tyes\n/volume/11\t90\t100\tyes\n/volume/12\t91\t100\tyes\n/volume/13\t0\t100\tyes\n/volume/14\t100\t100\tno\n/volume/15\t89\t100\tyes\n/volume/16\t90\t100\tyes\n/volume/17\t91\t100\tyes\n/volume/18\t0\t100\tyes\n/volume/19\t100\t100\tyes\n'}
import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/disk_alerts.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    before=get('health/disk.tsv')
    run('health/disk.tsv','alerts area/disk.tsv')
    expected='mount\tpercent\n'
    for line in before.splitlines()[1:]:
        name,used,capacity,enabled=line.split('\t');u=int(used);c=int(capacity)
        if enabled=='yes' and u*100>=c*90:expected+=f'{name}\t{u*100//c}\n'
    assert get('alerts area/disk.tsv') == expected and get('health/disk.tsv') == before
    put('small volumes.tsv','mount\tused\tcapacity\tenabled\n/z\t9\t10\tyes\n/a\t179\t200\tyes\n/c\t181\t200\tyes\n/b\t10\t10\tno\n')
    run('small volumes.tsv','alerts area/disk.tsv')
    assert get('alerts area/disk.tsv') == 'mount\tpercent\n/c\t90\n/z\t90\n'
    put('small volumes.tsv','mount\tused\tcapacity\tenabled\n/empty\t0\t5\tyes\n')
    run('small volumes.tsv','alerts area/disk.tsv');assert get('alerts area/disk.tsv') == 'mount\tpercent\n'
    put('large disks.tsv','mount\tused\tcapacity\tenabled\n/below\t89999999999999999999\t100000000000000000000\tyes\n/exact\t90000000000000000000\t100000000000000000000\tyes\n')
    run('large disks.tsv','alerts area/disk.tsv')
    assert get('alerts area/disk.tsv') == 'mount\tpercent\n/exact\t90\n'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import csv,sys
from pathlib import Path
src,out=map(Path,sys.argv[1:3]);rows=[]
with src.open() as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\t'):
        used=int(r['used']);capacity=int(r['capacity'])
        if r['enabled']=='yes' and used*100>=capacity*90:
            rows.append((r['mount'],used*100//capacity))
rows.sort()
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_text('mount\tpercent\n'+''.join(f'{name}\t{percent}\n' for name,percent in rows))
PY
